clips.title: The story
paras: At the Gallina Winery in Stormwind City, Suzetta Gallina tends the family wine business.

Suzetta Gallina helps run the Gallina Winery along Stormwind's Canals. The shop offers wines imported from across the kingdom or crafted there. Her family supplies taverns, nobles, and common folk. Suzetta is no figure in high politics, but her work keeps the capital's trade moving through troubled times.
